fr.elements: Main Residence; Front Driveway; Vehicle Parking Area; Walkway; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Multiple Structures; Limited Side Access; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the street in both directions.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the main residence and detached structure.
• Mark or label the detached structure with its address or unit identifier so responders can distinguish it from the main residence on arrival.
• Clear a walking path wide enough for responders carrying equipment along the side of the property to reach the rear.
• Keep any side gates unlocked or secured with a combination lock with the code shared with the local fire and police departments.
• Identify and mark the most direct foot path between the main residence and the detached structure for responders staging between the two buildings.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Open Terrain; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Multiple Access Routes; Scattered Shrubs
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees in the cluster nearest to the structure to increase open space between the trees and the building.
• Remove any shrubs growing directly against or immediately next to the structure.
• Keep scattered shrubs separated from one another to reduce connected pathways of vegetation toward the structure.
• Trim low-hanging branches on trees closest to the structure.
• Keep all access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching shrubs.
• Maintain open terrain areas free of debris, dead plant material, and woody buildup.
